title: A novel capillary electrophoresis-laser-induced fluorescence detection method using immobilized quantum dots for the determination of organophosphorus pesticides in vegetables
authors: Q. Chen and Y. Fung

pairs.product: CdTe/CdS core/shell quantum dots (QD) capped with MPA

steps.description: Rinsing new capillary using 0.1 M NaOH, followed by standing in 0.1 M NaOH solution overnight
A syringe pump was used to introduce a toluene solution of MPTS (5 103 mol/L) into the capillary through its open end until it reaches a 2 cm length and then standing for 6 h

The capillary was then rinsed with chloroform, acetone and deionized water to remove physically absorbed molecules, and then subjected to drying for 1 h at 1201C under nitrogen purging before cooling in a desiccator to stabilize the three-dimensional organic silica gel network deposited

The capillary/microfluidic device was filled with QD (6.7 104 mol/L with reference to Te) and then standing for 2 h to allow QD immobilization to complete, and finally washed with deionized water before drying by passing nitrogen gases
